messages:
vera-fin: Heads-up 3 customer Atlas reported an APAC billing spike on 2026-03-02. They attached a CSV and claim ~600k duplicate embed rows. Can eng/data confirm quickly?

sam-eng: send org_id and sample request_ids, I'll do a quick distinct vs raw count.

nina-data: org_id=atlas-prod. quick query run on embed_events for APAC between 02:05-03:20 UTC. Found ~603,214 extra rows when comparing raw vs distinct request_id counts.

sam-eng: quick log snippet from apac-proxy shows upstream 502 then 200 for same request_id, client retry behavior: 

```
[2026-03-02T02:12:03Z] apac-proxy-7 upstream=502 request_id=hz-77 attempt=1 ack=true
[2026-03-02T02:12:04Z] apac-proxy-7 upstream=200 request_id=hz-77 attempt=2 ack=true
```

sam-eng: root cause likely proxy errors + client retries; our ingest pipeline dedupes later so duplicates persisted.

vera-fin: propose provisional credit $660 (rounding up) pending full dedupe/replay. I'll approve if data confirms.

nina-data: starting full dedupe+replay job now; ETA ~2.5h. If final duplicates ~603k, provisional $660 sounds right (we bill $0.0011/embed for this tier).

billing-bot: created ticket FIN-2401 provisional credit $660 for atlas-prod period=2026-03-02 reason="apac proxy duplicate ingest" status=pending-approval.

vera-fin: approved provisional credit. @linda-cs please notify the customer that we've issued a provisional credit and will reconcile after recount.

sam-eng: will follow up in thread with final reconciliation table once job finishes.
